name: Nihon Knowledge Co,Ltd.
summary: Nihon Knowledge Co., Ltd., formed in 1985 with headquarters in Tokyo, Japan, provides technology services in Japan, specializing in software system verification, custom system development and business system packages. Services include software testing support, quality enhancement, test automation consulting and development process optimization. Its products include DEFESA Logger for operation logs, DEFESA REC, a recording system, monoPack, and mono + WEB Separation, a web isolation solution.
